metadata.purpose: Measure whether a candidate search-discovery provider can actually reach real IDX (Indonesian) and US issuer/financial-news sources for a tracked ticker. This suite evaluates COVERAGE, not evidence quality — a returned URL proves only that the provider can see the source, never that its content is true or usable. Promotion to evidence requires the separate fetch-and-classify pipeline (R-013).
metadata.threshold_note: market_hit_rate is 0.66, not 0.67, to express 'at least 2 of 3 cases'. The first live run (2026-07-26) tripped the gate at exactly 2/3 = 0.6667 against a 0.67 threshold — a representation bug, not a coverage finding. Raising the bar is a deliberate decision to make explicitly, not something that should happen by rounding.
metadata.domain_verification_note: expected_domains lists were assembled from general knowledge of each issuer and of major Indonesian financial outlets. They have NOT been verified against each issuer's live IR site. A miss caused by a wrong expected domain is a suite bug, not a provider failure — inspect returnedUrls in the report before drawing a coverage conclusion.
metadata.market_balance_note: The two US cases are experimental controls, not the subject under test. If US coverage is strong and ID coverage is weak, the provider has an Indonesian-coverage gap. If BOTH are weak, the harness or query construction is at fault.

deterministic_fixture.fixture_rationale: Deliberately returns only generic aggregator domains — the realistic thin-coverage outcome for an IDX mid cap, and the negative path the grader must be able to report. If every fixture in this suite were a hit, the deterministic mode could not fail and would prove nothing (the exact defect found in the M001 multimodal suite during M007 Slice 7).
